SMART_PLAY_LAST_PLAYED_HINT: Resume and the next episode play this quality automatically
SMART_PLAY_QUALITY_CHANGED: {{quality}} isn't offered for this episode, so {{fallback}} is used instead
SMART_PLAY_START_BUFFER: Buffering {{seconds}} s before playing: this source is still speeding up
SMART_PLAY_AHEAD_QUEUED: Downloading {{episode}} in {{quality}}: {{size}} GB, {{ratio}}× the speed it needs
SMART_PLAY_AHEAD_QUEUED_LOWER: Downloading {{episode}} in {{quality}} ({{size}} GB, {{ratio}}× the speed it needs): no source in your quality keeps up
SMART_PLAY_AHEAD_DESCRIPTION: While an episode plays, download the next one from the fastest source in your quality (or the closest one that keeps up), so it plays from disk without buffering. A download that falls behind is replaced. The server keeps downloading after Stremio closes, up to 60 GB; watched episodes are deleted first.
SMART_PLAY_AHEAD_REPLACED: The {{passedSize}} GB download of {{episode}} fell behind ({{oldRatio}}× the speed it needs), so it was replaced by {{size}} GB {{quality}} ({{ratio}}×)
SMART_PLAY_PORT_UNREACHABLE: No peer could connect to you (port {{port}}). Small swarms will be slow: forward this port on your router.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_STORAGE_HINT: Accent: Stremio's files. Grey: everything else on the disk. Dark: free.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_LOW_BANNER: Low disk space: {{free}} free. Delete what you don't need anymore.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_LOW_TOAST: Low disk space: {{free}} GB free. Click to review downloads
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_UNKNOWN_HINT: Files whose name doesn't say which show they're from
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_CONNECTING_HINT: Looking for peers that have this file
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_READING_INFO_HINT: Asking the swarm for this torrent's file list, to know the file's size
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_NO_INFO_HINT: Nobody in the swarm answered with this torrent's file list, so its size isn't known. Asked again at the next start
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_CONFIRM_BODY: The data is removed from disk. Playing it again downloads it again.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_STOP_BODY: Its download stops and the data is removed from disk. A next-episode download won't start again by itself.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_PLAYING_HINT: A player has this file open right now
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_TEST_HINT: Only the start is downloaded, to measure this source against others before playing. Deleted on its own when the test ends
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_THIS_BETTER: This copy is the better one.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_OTHER_BETTER: The other copy is better; this one is probably safe to delete.
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_QUALITY_HINT: Read from the file name. Bitrate is the file's size divided by the episode's runtime: higher means more picture detail
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_PLAYING_NO_DELETE: Playing now: stop playback to delete it
SMART_PLAY_DOWNLOADS_DUPLICATE_HINT: {{episode}} is on disk more than once. The other copies:
SMART_PLAY_ON_DISK_HINT: On disk: plays from disk at once ({{size}} GB)
SMART_PLAY_MATCH_HINT: Exact match: the quality you chose. Same resolution: another label at that resolution. Highest available: the best lower resolution offered
SMART_PLAY_NONE_HEALTHY: No source keeps up: playing the fastest ({{size}} GB, {{ratio}}× its need)
SMART_PLAY_AHEAD_WEAK: Downloading {{episode}} in {{quality}} ({{size}} GB): no source keeps up, this is the fastest ({{ratio}}× the speed it needs)
